subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw define a new core session-level process/step event contract now, and what schema, replay, ordering, redaction, and permission model should it use?
rationale: This would create a public core event contract and expose intermediate run state, so automation should not choose the taxonomy, persistence, or authorization boundary alone.

options.title: Design the core contract
options.body: Approve a scoped process/step event design with redaction, permissions, replay or refresh semantics, ordering, and mappings from existing progress streams before implementation.

options.title: Extend existing streams
options.body: Treat item, plan, session.tool, and task-ledger events as the canonical progress model and fill only the gaps needed by clients.

options.title: Defer to narrower consumers
options.body: Leave the broad process contract deferred while solving sessions_send progress, native Codex UI progress, and CLI JSON streaming independently.

recommendation.title: Design the core contract
recommendation.body: Approve a scoped process/step event design with redaction, permissions, replay or refresh semantics, ordering, and mappings from existing progress streams before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest existing structured progress work and current event definitions trace through steipete/Peter Steinberger in the inspected history.
